prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1412; do not mention it.)
text: I was stopped at a red light on Broadway Street in Pearland, Texas, waiting behind a line of traffic, when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The vehicle behind me had not slowed in time and struck the rear of my car at what I estimate was a moderate speed. My head snapped back and then forward against the headrest. I exited my vehicle and spoke with the other driver, who admitted that they had looked down at their phone for a moment. Neither of us was seriously hurt in terms of bleeding or visible damage to the cabin, but the next morning I woke with stiffness and pain in my neck and upper back, along with headaches. I have since been advised by a doctor that the symptoms are consistent with whiplash, and I am following the recommended course of treatment.
